description: Your company's cases: the reviews RepuTend found disputable or worth a look, with their state, tier and the Trustpilot reason and subtype each is reported under, newest first, each with next: the person's next step on it and the words they can say to you for it; show it to them when it is not null. Closed cases only with include_closed. After a burst of negative reviews it also says Attack Mode is suggested, with its price; it is never entered without you (quote_attack_mode, set_attack_mode). (capability: cases.read_own)

company.description: The company to act for, by its Trustpilot domain (for example aioseo.com), one of those list_companies shows. Needed only when your key reaches more than one company.

name: list_disputable_reviews
